Name: Simple Fishing Mod
Author: FelineWasteland
Description:
Really bad at fishing? Just don't care for the minigame? Here's a simple workaround.

[u]HOW IT WORKS
[/u]Sets the "difficulty" of every fish to "0" and movement type to "smooth", enabling guaranteed catching of anything you reel in. This means that when the fishing screen pops up, the little fish image will sit at the bottom of the bar, and you will be able to catch it by simply waiting a few moments.

This does not affect the probability of encountering certain fish, nor anything to do with crab pots, it simply allows for painless catching.

The downside is that you will mostly likely not be able to open treasure chests, should they spawn while you are fishing.

Does not affect catching tutorial fish, but should affect all others. Tested in SDV 1.6.

CAUTION: Might not be compatible with other mods that effect fishing.

[u]INSTRUCTIONS[/u]
1. Navigate to [b]Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Content > Data[/b].
2. Find [b]Fish.xnb[/b], and rename it to something like "Fish_backup.xnb".
3. Download the .rar file.
4. Extract the [i]new[/i] [b]Fish.xnb[/b] file from the .rar, and place it into the [b]Data[/b] folder.

The game will now read the modded file as if it were the original.

[u]2026 Update: v1.2.1
[/u]Updated for SDV 1.6. Changed all movement types to smooth (1.1.0 only changed difficulty). Fixed typo in 1.2.0 that was causing errors.

[u]POTENTIAL DEVELOPMENTS
[/u]- Enabling this mod in other languages
- Autocollect treasure chests
